name: Time Period
definition: Particular time span specified between a start time and an end time. The time period cannot exceed 24 hours.

FromTime.name: From Time
FromTime.definition: Time at which the time span starts.

ToTime.name: To Time
ToTime.definition: Time at which the time span ends.

SystemAvailability.name: System Availability
SystemAvailability.definition: System for which a session period is specified.
